scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @abou/api" "npm run dev -w @abou/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @abou/contracts && npm run build -w @abou/api && npm run build -w @abou/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @abou/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @abou/api && npm run typecheck -w @abou/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @abou/contracts && npm run test -w @abou/api && npm run test -w @abou/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @abou/contracts && npm run lint -w @abou/api && npm run lint -w @abou/web
